name: 55402 · Minneapolis, MN
findings: ZIP 55402 (Minneapolis) has 296 nonprofit organizations. 107 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 90 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55402 (Minneapolis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55402 (Minneapolis) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 48.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 90 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.
